blocks.x: The contract behind Tele Medicine Platform — Architecture & Trust: signed baseline in week two, working slice by week eight, industrialized controls by week twelve, and evidence flowing to your control owner throughout.

The platform separates three planes. The data plane carries workload (identity, posture, segmentation, workload identity, versioned rules with CI testing, policy-as-code with fix-the-pipeline flows); the control plane carries policy and orchestration (injection filtering, containment, red-teaming, workforce/CIAM/machine lifecycle); the evidence plane carries audit, replay and conformity documentation — the plane most vendors skip and every regulator asks about.

blocks.note: Data flows uphill under contract: what the center learns from the edge is agreed, versioned and auditable like every other boundary.

blocks.x: Sentinel assumes breach and designs for audit: purple-team validation of segmentation, restore-tested backups, AI red-team suites with findings-to-fix tracking. The platform's own controls are SOC 2 Type II audited and ISO 27001 certified.

items: The control estate mapped to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 criteria, evidence produced continuously.
Sector rules translated into controls per jurisdiction — the mapping is data, reviewed when the regime moves.
AI-specific obligations mapped to controls — model risk, transparency and human oversight, owned by name.

blocks.x: The performance envelope for Tele Medicine Platform — Architecture & Trust is published: latency, quality and cost bands the system is engineered to hold, with breaches treated as incidents, not as rounding.
The program dashboard tracks these by default, wired to your channels:

items: Freshness attainment published per dataset — data age is uptime, treated the same way.
Breakage restored and measured — the repair clock starts at alert, not at someone noticing.
Batch windows measured against the plan every run — the number reported is the observed one.
Deployed inside your tenancy, your keys, your logs — the default for regulated estates.
Operated by us under contract — SLOs published, changes gated, your auditors given a walkthrough path.
Split by design: what must stay local stays local, what benefits from scale scales.

blocks.x: Tele Medicine Platform — Architecture & Trust runs on the same delivery standard as the rest of the portfolio: measure first, gate honestly, and let the evidence decide what scales.

items: A single governance plane over tables, models and notebooks — access your auditors can replay.
Typed schemas with owners and freshness expectations, agreed before a pipeline is allowed to ship.
Data age treated like uptime — a budget, an owner and an alert when it slips.
Open table formats underneath everything we build, so your data never belongs to a vendor.
